The '''''Imperial Stormtrooper Corps Field Manual''''' (or '''''ISCFM''''' for short) was the official military guidebook for strategies, branches, units, and equipment for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]]. At least six excerpts from the ''Field Manual'' were included in the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''.
